summary: The statement and proof are correct relative to the supplied accepted predecessors. The entropy and ordinary centerpoint bounds apply to the same finite nonzero midpoint measure, and attainment plus the pointwise lift places both bounds at a single maximizer in the original central fiber. The centered-ball construction, translated intersection, and positive homothety give the asserted reflection-mass comparison with the stated exponent and inequality directions. Real volume symmetry is used exactly in the fiber-volume identity, without assuming symmetry of the original fiber shapes. The second-derivative estimate and exponential bound yield the stated absolute threshold constant. The radius-free corollary uses only lattice volume symmetry and unconditional slice-radius concavity. Checks of the smallest dimensions, nearest-integer ties, integer centers, zero-volume boundary fibers, rank zero, vertical closed halfspaces, and the threshold endpoint reveal no error or gap.
